display_long_description:
Doll Play Helper is an experimental mixed reality sandbox for doll collectors and creative enthusiasts.
Design and customize beautiful virtual rooms and interiors for your real dolls using a wide library of furniture and decor objects — all in your real space, thanks to MR on Meta Quest!

No more cardboard houses or expensive accessories: simply place your dolls in the real world, and build their perfect digital environment around them.

**Key Features:**
- Intuitive MR interface for Meta Quest (controllers + hand tracking)
-Drag-and-drop furniture and decor objects into your real space
- Save, load, and manage your custom rooms
- Search and filter your object library
- Delete, move, and arrange items to your liking
 -Optimized for play with real dolls: combine physical and virtual worlds!

**Who is it for?**

- Doll collectors (Barbie, Monster High, BJD, MLP, etc.)

- Kids, parents, and creative adults who love to build and decorate

- Anyone wanting to experiment with MR and personal creative spaces

**Early Access / Experimental:**

This is an early prototype made for creative fun and feedback from the community.
If you have ideas, requests, or find bugs, please let me know — your feedback is very welcome!
